title: Weekly Cohort Retention
dataset_names: Pre-signup activity, inactive users, Sunday signups
hints: Assign each user a cohort_week = date_trunc('week', signup_date) and compute each cohort's size separately (users with zero activity still count in the size).
Join activity to the user's cohort and compute week_number = (date_trunc('week', activity_date) - cohort_week) / 7 using integer division; drop negative week numbers.
COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) per (cohort_week, week_number) so several activities in the same week count once; divide by cohort size for the percentage.
